<meta name="twitter:description" content="How did we find the spot? We searched for a whole year - where you could find guaranteed wind in the Philippines, where you can easily travel too and where there is a shallow bay easy to learn for beginners with side on shore wind. Our tools- windy and googlemaps. Welcome to Bislig Beach: flat water with loads of space on the water and the most reliable wind the Philippines has to offer- a little bit stronger then on kiters top spot Boracay, which is only 50 km away! The wind conditions here are heavenly from November to April. The beginner kite spot is situated right outside your bungalow/glamping tent. Set out, pump and off you go Kitesurfing! Outside of the reef you have deep water and you can go on long downwinders to 8 different islands outside by wing or kite. You can do downwinders or daytrips to one of the islands nearby: the choice of kitespots is yours."/>

<meta property="og:description" content="How did we find the spot? We searched for a whole year - where you could find guaranteed wind in the Philippines, where you can easily travel too and where there is a shallow bay easy to learn for beginners with side on shore wind. Our tools- windy and googlemaps. Welcome to Bislig Beach: flat water with loads of space on the water and the most reliable wind the Philippines has to offer- a little bit stronger then on kiters top spot Boracay, which is only 50 km away! The wind conditions here are heavenly from November to April. The beginner kite spot is situated right outside your bungalow/glamping tent. Set out, pump and off you go Kitesurfing! Outside of the reef you have deep water and you can go on long downwinders to 8 different islands outside by wing or kite. You can do downwinders or daytrips to one of the islands nearby: the choice of kitespots is yours."/>

<script id="cc-m-reg-7218164918"></script></div><div id="cc-m-7218165018" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7218165018">The Spot</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7218165118" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    How did we find the spot? We searched for a whole year - where you could find guaranteed wind in the Philippines, where you can easily travel too and where there is a shallow bay easy to learn
    for beginners with side on shore wind. Our tools- windy and googlemaps. Welcome to Bislig Beach: flat <strong>water </strong> with loads of space on the water and the <strong>most reliable
    wind the Philippines</strong> has to offer- a little bit stronger then on kiters top spot Boracay, which is only 50 km away! The <strong>wind</strong> conditions here are heavenly <strong>from
    November to April.</strong> The <strong>beginner kite spot is situated right outside your bungalow/glamping tent</strong>. Set out, pump and off you go Kitesurfing! Outside of the reef you have
    deep water and you can go on long downwinders to 8 different islands outside by wing or kite. You can do downwinders or daytrips to one of the  islands nearby: the choice of kitespots is
    yours.
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7218165218" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7218165218">Kitecourses &amp; Rentals</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7218165318" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 20px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7218165418" class="j-module n j-hgrid ">    <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column" style="width: 71.67%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-1816806318"><div id="cc-m-7218165518" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    Fast learning success combined with loads of fun. Our lessons are taught by <strong>experienced Instructors</strong>. We teach with the standard of  <strong>VDWS</strong> (Verband deutscher
    Wassersport Schulen). We teach both sports in the conditions needed - flat water without waves. Kitesurfing we teach in shallow waste deep water. Wingfoiling in deep water, not to get worried
    about reefs or sandbars.<br/>
    At the end of the course you will receive an international license to justify your level. Once certified, you will be able to rent gear in any Watersportscenter worldwide. The equipment is
    checked daily for your safety! We fly latest 2024 North Gear.
</p></div></div>    </div>
            <div class="cc-m-hgrid-separator" data-display="cms-only"><div></div></div>
